fixes.what: Add `.cel figure{padding-right:24px}` (or `width:calc(100% - 24px)`) so the photo slot ends ~64px from the right edge; the slot itself has no clearance, only .cel figcaption does.
fixes.why: index-phone-2.jpg: the settled 'How we work +' tab sits ~18px over the right edge of the Nikah photo link; a fixed control over a clickable slot breaks the 'controls never cover content' rule on phones.

fixes.where: index.html : the tree-full.webp preload and the four .tree__layer
fixes.what: Preload canopy-L0.webp and canopy-L1.webp (as=image, fetchpriority=high, same reduced-motion media) and drop tree-full from the preload list; give the .tree__trunk--low, .tree__sprig, .tree__bark and .ground-art imgs `loading="lazy"`.
fixes.why: On screen 1 the only tree pixels are the four layers; tree-full (the largest file) paints from screen 2 down yet is fetched first at high priority, delaying the layers that are actually in the first paint.

fixes.what: Add 768 / 1024 variants with `srcset` and `sizes="(max-width:768px) 110vw, 100vw"`, matching tree-full's three widths.
fixes.why: A 390px phone at DPR 2 needs ~858 device px but downloads four 1536-wide layers; the tree-full comment already documents the right sizing and the layers skip it.
Lenis passes its instance as the first argument, so `noRefresh` is truthy and the ScrollTrigger.refresh() the comment promises after an anchor jump never runs.

fixes.what: Replace the per-frame `canopy.getBoundingClientRect()` with a cached in-view flag from the existing IntersectionObserver (loopInView already observes the layers), checked after the velocity gate.
fixes.why: With Lenis every frame is a scroll update; a layout read inside the fast-scroll path forces sync layout exactly when the page is busiest.

fixes.what: Measure the rendered tab at 390px (index-phone-2.jpg shows ~58px, not 34) and set an explicit `inline-size`/`width` (e.g. 36px) with `line-height:16px` honoured in vertical-rl, then re-derive the 24px/44px clearances from the real width.
fixes.why: Every phone clearance in site.css and canopy.css is computed from a 34px assumption that the screenshots contradict.
